verdict.rationale: Docusign has a public Developer Center and REST API reference plus OpenAPI/Swagger specs used to generate SDKs, showing a structured, machine-readable API reference exists, but nothing in the pack confirms an interactive 'try it now' console or runnable code examples embedded in the docs. Probes for openapi.json/llms.txt discovery paths returned 404s, and community comments criticize the documentation quality rather than confirming interactivity. missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' / runnable code sandbox in the API reference, confirmation of llms.txt or machine-discoverable API reference for agents, and independent corroboration of the interactive experience.
